Copy.description: Creates a copy of the current shape.
Copy.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

FitText.description:
Changes the font size of the shape text so that the text fits the shape height.
The text is reduced if it does not fit the shape. If canEnlarge is true, the text is also enlarged to fill the free space of the shape.
All the text sizes are changed in the same proportion, the line spacing is not changed.
The text is never enlarged if it is not wrapped or the shape is resized to fit the text.

params.description: Specifies whether the text can be enlarged to fill the shape height.
params.name: canEnlarge

FitText.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

returns.description: Returns true if the text fits the shape.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiShape class.

GetGeometry.description: Returns the geometry object from the current shape.

GetLine.description: Gets the outline properties from the current shape.

GetParentSheet.description: Returns the parent sheet of the current drawing.

GetPosition.description: Returns the cell anchor of the current drawing; the offsets are limited by the anchor cell.

returns.description: returns null for an absolutely positioned drawing.

GetVerticalTextAlign.description: Gets the vertical alignment from the shape content where a paragraph or text runs can be inserted.
